data.one_liner: Detects when the Flutter app goes to the background or foreground at the app level.
data.what_it_does: Detects true app-level background and foreground events rather than individual Activity or ViewController state changes. Provides a built-in widget and a stream to listen for lifecycle transitions.
use_when: You need to detect true app-level background and foreground transitions
You want to avoid false triggers caused by opening new activities, view controllers, or FaceID prompts
avoid_when: You only need standard widget binding observations for embedding activities
strengths: Avoids false positives from native container changes like FaceID prompts
Provides both a reactive widget and an event stream
Includes ignoreWhile API to bypass specific events like image picking
weaknesses: Can be triggered by actions like picking an image on newer Android versions that open external apps
Requires a clean build after adding to integrate native code
data.setup_notes: Requires a clean build to integrate the plugin native code into the app.
